note: Greybox room library for spec stage 3. Rooms are never scaled and never rotated: instead the library carries one room per exact doorway side-set, so every one of the 15 non-empty subsets of {N,E,S,W} has a room whose sockets match it exactly. chamber_2x2_nesw is the smallest all-sides room, so a candidate exists even when the free space around a node is only 2x2. Socket offsets run along the side in the clockwise direction used by connection slots: north west-to-east, east north-to-south, south east-to-west, west south-to-north.
